resources.string: Draws the Dynamic Island around the camera, over any app and any home screen. It reads nothing on the screen; only “Screen text” in the island takes a screenshot, read on this device.
Needs “WEWEWE Island” in the accessibility settings, the only way Android lets apps draw around the camera.
